scope: Corollary 10 (Majority and symmetric functions) of the manuscript “Product-projection localization and the QAC0 parity lower bound” (preprints/Product-projection-localization-and-the-QAC0-parity-lower-bound-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 274 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 12393c9f997aa808), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 17. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let (fn) be a symmetric Boolean family satisfying either ρ(fn) ≥ nδ for some fixed δ > 0, or ˜︃ deg1/3(fn) = Ω(n1/2+η) for some fixed η > 0, for all sufficiently large n. For every fixed γ > 0, no nonuniform family in the circuit model of Theorem 1, with fixed depth and polynomially many total qubits, computes fn with probability at least 1/2 + 1/(log n)γ on every input for all sufficiently large n. In particular, this excludes strict majority MAJn(x) = 1{|x| > n/2}, whose transition radius is ⌈n/2⌉.
